description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of reading and writing .gitmodules in various conditional scenarios involving sparse checkouts and submodules. It contains setup routines, test cases, and commands to verify Git submodule configurations without the .gitmodules file being checked out.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expected to fail, marking the test as successful if failure occurs.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock (used in Git tests).

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after the current test completes for cleanup or setup.
